Which refactoring approach would you prefer?</question> <follow_up> <suggest>Start with extract method refactoring to reduce method length</suggest> <suggest>Focus on breaking down large classes first for biggest impact</suggest> <suggest>Apply parameter object refactoring to reduce parameter count</suggest> <suggest>Use strategy pattern to eliminate conditional complexity</suggest> </follow_up> </ask_followup_question>
